card.name: Inside rare names and split words
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of a rarely seen proper name or word split into parts, such as Mah-n-mal, Cro-Magnon, Komnenos or mourner. The marked piece is usually a few letters after a capitalized start.

modes.label: Names split in pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of a person or group name, often non-English or historical.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: A piece inside a rare word, term or abbreviation.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of unusual names and long words that the model reads in several pieces.
